starter.prompt_addendum: IMPORTANT: Before writing any code, scaffold a WinUI 3 project by running: dotnet new winui -n {app_name} --output "{app_dir}". This gives you the correct csproj setup, App.xaml, MainWindow, and package.appxmanifest. Build the app on top of this project.

candidate.prompt_addendum: IMPORTANT: A WinUI 3 project has already been scaffolded in {app_dir}. Do NOT run 'dotnet new winui' -- the project structure (csproj, App.xaml, MainWindow, appxmanifest) is already in place. Build your app on top of the existing project.
